proposed_widenings.name: SummonCreaturesOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's core mechanic is animating objects into Constructs under caster control. This maps to the v4 'create_companion' effect atom. OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit; neither can express creature summoning. A new OngoingOperation variant (e.g., 'summon_companions') is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each target animates, sprouts legs, and becomes a Construct that uses the Animated Object stat block; this creature is under your control until the spell ends or until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

proposed_widenings.name: CommandCompanionsOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants a Bonus Action command channel over the summoned creatures. This maps to the v4 'command_companion' atom but has no surface representation. It could be a second OngoingOperation variant or a rider on the summon variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 500 feet of you.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_modifier LevelAxis
proposed_widenings.justification: The cap on how many objects can be animated equals the caster's spellcasting ability modifier — a runtime value, not a character/class/slot/subclass/PB level. LevelAxis needs an 'ability_modifier' (or 'spellcasting_ability_modifier') variant to express this scale.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The maximum number of objects is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

proposed_widenings.name: PerSizeClassSlotScaling
proposed_widenings.justification: Higher-level casting increases Slam damage by a different die per object size category (1d4 Medium-or-smaller, 1d6 Large, 1d12 Huge) per slot above 5. No existing DiceAmount or SlotScaling shape can express conditional-per-size-class damage deltas. A new scaling variant keyed by object size would be needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature's Slam damage increases by 1d4 (Medium or smaller), 1d6 (Large), or 1d12 (Huge) for each spell slot level above 5.

notes: Animate Objects is a summoning spell — it creates Constructs from objects and gives the caster ongoing control via Bonus Action commands. The structural home is ongoing_effect (concentration duration, caster maintains control while active), which correctly fits. The blockers are all surface-level: OngoingOperation lacks a summon/companion-creation variant; LevelAxis lacks ability_modifier; and no DiceAmount shape handles per-size-class conditional slot scaling. The v4 atoms create_companion and command_companion exist in the taxonomy; they are simply not exposed in types.ts yet. No new top-level family or kind is required.
